services.name: Samaritans of Singapore (SOS)
services.desc: 24-hour emotional support for people in crisis or with thoughts of suicide or self-harm. Also supports those bereaved by suicide.

services.name: National mindline 1771
services.desc: National 24/7 mental health line for distress or crisis. Call, text or chat, and get linked to further care.

services.name: IMH Emergency Services
services.desc: 24-hour psychiatric emergency service and helpline for acute risk or severe symptoms.

services.name: Emergency services
services.desc: Ambulance 995 for medical emergencies or imminent risk to life. Police 999 for immediate danger.
services.other: Police SMS: 70999; SCDF fire or medical emergency SMS: 70995

services.name: SAMH Helpline
services.desc: Counselling, community mental health and recovery services for adults and youth. Provides information and assistance on mental health and psychosocial issues. Helpline: Monday to Friday 9am to 6pm.

services.name: Silver Ribbon (Singapore)
services.desc: Mental health literacy, anti-stigma work and counselling support.

services.name: Care Corner Counselling Helpline
services.desc: Mandarin counselling for individuals, couples and families on mental health, personal challenges, grief, pre-marital, marital, family and relationship issues. Helpline: daily 10am to 10pm.

services.name: CHAT
services.desc: Mental health check-ins and assessment for young people aged 16 to 30. webCHAT offers in-the-moment text-based support for emotional concerns, clarity and help finding support. webCHAT: Tuesday to Saturday 1pm to 8pm (hours from the October 2024 contributed resource list; check before referring).

services.name: All Addictions Helpline
services.desc: Assessment and treatment for drug, alcohol, gambling, gaming and other addictions. All Addictions Helpline (6-RECOVER): 24 hours.

services.name: Community-Based Addictions Counselling
services.desc: Community-based addictions counselling for individuals struggling with addictive behaviours, including substance use and alcohol, gambling, internet / gaming, and sex and pornography.

services.name: National Problem Gambling Helpline
services.desc: Help for people with gambling problems and their families, including information on exclusion orders.

services.name: Alcoholics Anonymous Singapore
services.desc: Peer support groups for people who want to stop drinking.

services.name: Singapore Anti-Narcotics Association (SANA)
services.desc: Aftercare, counselling and reintegration support for people recovering from drug use, and their families.

services.name: Sexual Assault Care Centre (SACC)
services.desc: Support for survivors of sexual assault and harassment of any gender: helpline, case management, and accompaniment to police and medical services. Helpline: Monday to Friday 10am to 6pm.

services.name: National Anti-Violence and Sexual Harassment Helpline
services.org: Ministry of Social and Family Development
services.desc: 24-hour helpline to report or get help for family violence, sexual violence, harassment, abuse and neglect. Provides psychological support to callers in distress.

services.name: AWARE Women's Care Centre Helpline
services.desc: Helpline, counselling and legal clinic for women facing abuse or discrimination. Offers emotional support, information and encouragement in English, Mandarin, Malay and Tamil. Helpline: Monday to Friday 10am to 6pm.

services.name: PAVe
services.org: Centre for Promoting Alternatives to Violence
services.desc: Family violence specialist centre offering counselling for survivors, children and people who use violence.

services.name: ComCare Hotline
services.org: Ministry of Social and Family Development
services.desc: Financial assistance for low-income individuals and families, and links to the nearest Social Service Office or Family Service Centre for case management on family, social and emotional issues. Hotline: daily 7am to midnight.

services.name: Credit Counselling Singapore
services.desc: Free debt counselling and debt management programmes for individuals with unsecured debt.

services.name: SupportGoWhere
services.desc: Searchable list of government support schemes and services with an eligibility checker.

services.name: Family Service Centres
services.org: MSF network, run by various agencies
services.desc: Neighbourhood centres for casework, counselling and coordinated help for families. Find the nearest one through MSF.

links.label: Full list of FSCs in Operation

services.name: BABES Pregnancy Crisis Support
services.desc: Support for teenagers and young women facing unplanned pregnancy.

services.name: Pregnancy Support and Residential Respite Services
services.desc: For pregnant women up to 32 weeks' gestation (any age or nationality). Offers social work assessment and case management, parentcraft coaching, and at least 12 months of baby essentials (eligibility criteria apply). Residential respite (Singapore Citizens/PRs only): mother and baby may stay up to 4 months after birth.

links.label: Download Fact Sheet for Community Partners

services.name: Pregnancy Crisis Service
services.desc: Counselling and practical support for women in crisis pregnancy.

services.name: TOUCHline
services.desc: Counselling helpline for youth and their parents.

services.name: Tinkle Friend
services.desc: Support, advice and information for lonely or distressed primary-school-aged children aged 7 to 12, especially when parents or caregivers are unavailable. Helpline: Monday to Friday 2.30pm to 5pm. Webchat: Monday to Thursday 2.30pm to 7pm; Friday 2.30pm to 5pm.

services.name: Agency for Integrated Care
services.desc: Information on community care services for seniors and caregivers, and for individuals with mental health and emotional needs. Care options include home care, day care and respite. Hotline: Monday to Friday 8.30am to 8.30pm; Saturday 8.30am to 4pm.

services.name: Seniors Helpline
services.desc: Counselling and information helpline for people aged 50 and above on issues and services related to older persons. Free face-to-face counselling for seniors and their caregivers. Helpline: Monday to Friday 9am to 7pm; Saturday 9am to 1pm.

services.name: SG Enable
services.desc: First stop for disability services, schemes, employment support and assistive tech.

services.name: Migrant Workers' Centre
services.desc: Help for migrant workers with employment disputes, welfare and emergencies.

services.name: HOME
services.desc: Shelter, legal and welfare support for migrant workers, including domestic workers facing abuse.

services.name: MOM Helpline
services.desc: Employment and work pass enquiries. Weekdays 8.30am to 5.30pm.

services.name: Legal Aid Bureau
services.desc: Civil legal aid, including divorce, custody and maintenance, for people who meet the means test.

services.name: Pro Bono SG
services.desc: Free legal clinics and help for people who can't afford a lawyer.

services.name: Family Justice Courts: Personal Protection Orders
services.desc: How to apply for a PPO or Expedited Order against family violence.

services.name: Non-Emergency Ambulance Service
services.desc: Ambulance transport to hospital for non-emergency situations. Inform the operator of the patient’s condition and behaviour so a suitable nearby service can be activated. For medical emergencies, call 995.

services.name: Oogachaga Counselling
services.desc: Counselling for lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, questioning and queer (LGBTQ+) individuals, couples and families. WhatsApp support: Tuesday to Thursday 7pm to 10pm; Saturday 2pm to 5pm.

services.name: ResiL!ence
services.desc: Programmes for young people aged 12 to 25 with mental health needs, including emotional support, mentoring, counselling, support groups and mental health screening. Contact: Monday to Friday 9am to 6pm.

services.name: Limitless Counselling
services.desc: Free and subsidised counselling and psychological services for young people facing relationship issues, trauma, mental health concerns, self-image and behavioural challenges. Apply using the online form.

services.name: Youthline
services.desc: A listening ear and free counselling for anyone up to 35 years old. Phone and WhatsApp: daily 9am to midnight.

services.name: Wysa’s AI Chat / Mindline
services.desc: 24/7 AI chatbot for emotional wellbeing and self-help. This automated chat service is separate from the National mindline 1771 counselling helpline.

services.name: OTR Listens
services.desc: Anonymous text-based emotional support from trained volunteers. Chat: Monday to Friday 4pm to midnight; Saturday and Sunday noon to midnight. Contact details and hours are from the October 2024 contributed resource list; check before referring.

services.name: Hear4U
services.desc: Non-crisis psychological first aid and support for anyone in Singapore. WhatsApp: Monday to Friday 10am to 5pm. Contact details and hours are from the October 2024 contributed resource list; check before referring.

services.name: Singapore Association for the Deaf — Community Services
services.desc: Assistance for Deaf, hard-of-hearing and DeafBlind people and their families from social workers, case managers and community services staff. WhatsApp contact during office hours. Contact details and hours are from the October 2024 contributed resource list; check before referring.

services.name: TOUCH Silent Club
services.desc: Programmes supporting Deaf people in education, vocation, recreation, social development and independence. Contact: Tuesday to Friday 10am to noon and 2pm to 4pm; Saturday 10am to 3pm. Contact details and hours are from the October 2024 contributed resource list; check before referring.

services.name: NCSS Community Resources
services.desc: Community resource directory for finding further social service support.

services.name: IASP Suicide Prevention Resources
services.desc: International suicide prevention information and resources for people experiencing suicidal thoughts. For immediate support in Singapore, contact SOS 1767 or National mindline 1771; call 995 or 999 for immediate danger.

services.name: Allkin Family Service Centre @ Ang Mo Kio 230
services.desc: Allkin's Ang Mo Kio centre, run by the agency that opened Singapore's first FSC. Social workers and counsellors help residents with emotional, money and family difficulties, and link them to other community services.

services.name: Allkin Family Service Centre @ Yio Chu Kang 643
services.desc: Allkin service point for residents around Yio Chu Kang and Ang Mo Kio Avenue 5. Offers casework and counselling for family, financial and emotional issues, plus support groups and neighbourhood programmes.

services.name: Allkin Family Service Centre @ Cheng San 445
services.desc: Allkin centre for residents in the Cheng San area of Ang Mo Kio. Helps individuals and families work through family conflict, money worries and emotional stress, and connects them to community partners.

services.name: Allkin Family Service Centre @ Punggol 616
services.desc: Allkin's Punggol centre, offering casework and counselling for family, financial and emotional issues. Also runs intake, support groups and community programmes for local residents.

services.name: Allkin Family Service Centre @ Sengkang 223D
services.desc: Allkin's Sengkang centre for individuals and families facing emotional, financial or family challenges. Provides casework, counselling, support groups and referrals to community services.

services.name: AWWA Family Service Centre
services.desc: Long-running FSC at Towner Road supporting individuals and families through hardship, including financial difficulty and instability. Offers practical and emotional casework, peer support groups and community talks and outreach.

services.name: Care Corner Family Service Centre (Admiralty)
services.desc: Care Corner centre serving Admiralty and Woodlands residents. Case management for family, financial, housing, mental health and parenting concerns, with immediate support where there are safety risks such as family violence.

services.name: Care Corner Family Service Centre (Punggol)
services.desc: Care Corner's Punggol service point, sharing premises with Allkin's Punggol centre. Case management for family, financial, housing and emotional difficulties, with immediate help when there are safety concerns such as family violence.

services.name: Care Corner Family Service Centre (Queenstown)
services.desc: Care Corner centre at Tanglin Halt serving Queenstown residents. Supports families with financial strain, relationship conflict, mental health concerns and parenting, including immediate safety support for family violence.

services.name: Care Corner Family Service Centre (Tampines)
services.desc: Care Corner centre serving Tampines residents. Case management for family, financial, housing and emotional issues, group programmes, and immediate support where there are safety risks such as family violence.

services.name: Care Corner Family Service Centre (Toa Payoh)
services.desc: Care Corner centre at Lorong 1 Toa Payoh. Case management for family, financial, housing, mental health and parenting concerns, with immediate support where there are safety risks such as family violence.

services.name: Care Corner Family Service Centre (Woodlands)
services.desc: Care Corner centre serving Woodlands residents from Woodlands Street 32. Helps families with money stress, relationship conflict, housing and emotional difficulties, and gives immediate safety support for family violence.

services.name: Fei Yue Family Service Centre (Bukit Batok)
services.desc: Fei Yue's main Bukit Batok centre, from one of Singapore's earliest counselling agencies. Social workers assess each family's situation and offer casework, counselling, group programmes and referrals, working with SSOs and schools where needed.

services.name: Fei Yue Family Service Centre (Bukit Batok West)
services.desc: Extension office of Fei Yue's Bukit Batok centre, on the same phone line. Offers casework and counselling for personal, family and social difficulties, plus support groups and referrals.

services.name: Fei Yue Family Service Centre (Champions Way)
services.desc: Fei Yue centre in Woodlands at Champions Way. Supports individuals and families coping with emotional, personal and social challenges through casework, counselling, groups and community programmes.

services.name: Fei Yue Family Service Centre (Choa Chu Kang)
services.desc: Fei Yue centre for Choa Chu Kang residents, offering casework, counselling, groups and referrals. Fei Yue's MSF-appointed Strengthening Families Programme for marriage, divorce and family counselling is next door at Blk 281.

services.name: Fei Yue Family Service Centre (Yew Tee)
services.desc: Fei Yue centre serving the Yew Tee side of Choa Chu Kang. Social workers help families work through personal, social and emotional difficulties, with group programmes and referrals to community resources.

services.name: Fei Yue Family Services at SSO @ Taman Jurong
services.desc: Fei Yue family services based inside the Social Service Office at Corporation Drive, so families can get counselling and casework alongside SSO financial help in one place.

services.name: FRCS Family Service Centre (Clementi)
services.desc: Serves Clementi, West Coast and parts of Bukit Timah and Ulu Pandan, formerly Rotary FSC. Offers individual and family counselling for marital stress, parenting and anxiety, groups for children to seniors, and specialised help with reintegration and addiction recovery.

services.name: FRCS Family Service Centre (West Coast)
services.desc: FRCS branch opened in 2020 to make its services easier to reach for West Coast residents. Offers individual and family counselling, group programmes, and specialised help with reintegration and addiction recovery.

services.name: Good News Family Service Centre @ Pasir Ris
services.desc: Neighbourhood FSC for Pasir Ris residents, offering casework, counselling, information and referral, and group and community programmes for individuals and families with social and emotional difficulties.

services.name: Hougang Sheng Hong Family Service Centre
services.desc: Hougang centre offering individual, couple and family sessions, including home visits. Covers family violence, parenting and relationship issues, caregiver stress and money worries, and has run support groups for women recovering from family violence.

services.name: Kampong Kapor Family Service Centre
services.desc: Serves Jalan Besar, Kampong Glam, Tekka and Owen, with an extended area covering Mountbatten and Geylang. Social workers and counsellors help with financial, marital, parenting and personal concerns, alongside group and community work.

services.name: Lakeside Family Centre (Jurong East)
services.desc: One of Singapore's early FSCs, serving Jurong East. Helps with financial assessment and aid, marital, parenting and family disputes, and runs the Mandatory Counselling Programme for people with a Personal Protection Order.

services.name: Lakeside Family Centre (Jurong West)
services.desc: Lakeside's Jurong West centre. Casework and counselling for money, marital, parenting and family conflict issues, including the Mandatory Counselling Programme for people with a Personal Protection Order.

services.name: Montfort Care Family Service (Kreta Ayer)
services.desc: Montfort Care's FSC at Kreta Ayer Community Centre in Chinatown. Social workers help families with relationship and parenting challenges, stress, money difficulties and concerns about children or elderly members, and refer on where needed.

services.name: Montfort Care Family Service (Marine Parade)
services.desc: Montfort Care's Marine Terrace centre for Marine Parade residents. Supports families through relationship and parenting challenges, stress, financial difficulty and caregiving concerns, with referrals to other services.

services.name: Montfort Care Family Service (Telok Blangah)
services.desc: Montfort Care's Telok Blangah centre. Helps families facing relationship or parenting difficulties, stress, money problems and concerns about children or older family members, and links them to further support.

services.name: MWS Covenant Family Service Centre – Hougang
services.desc: MWS's main FSC and regional hub for Hougang, Sengkang and Serangoon, next to its marriage, divorce and parenting services on Hougang Ave 8. Handles family and marital conflict, parenting, financial difficulty and domestic violence using trauma-informed care.

services.name: MWS Covenant Family Service Centre – Buangkok
services.desc: Satellite office of MWS's Hougang centre, serving Buangkok residents. Offers information and referral, casework, counselling and group work for family and marital conflict, parenting, money difficulties and domestic violence.

services.name: MWS Family Service Centre – Sengkang West
services.desc: MWS's newest FSC, opened in August 2025 and operating for now from Allkin's Sengkang centre at Compassvale Walk. Provides casework, counselling, group work and referrals for Sengkang West residents.

services.name: MWS Family Service Centre – Tampines
services.desc: MWS centre at Tampines Street 44. Social workers and counsellors provide casework, counselling, group work and community programmes for individuals and families facing personal or family difficulties.

services.name: MWS Family Service Centre – Yishun
services.desc: MWS centre at Yishun Ring Road. Offers information and referral, casework and counselling, group work and community development for residents with personal or family-related issues.

services.name: PPIS Family Service Centre (East)
services.desc: PPIS centre at Wisma Geylang Serai. Free, secular casework and counselling for relationship difficulties, family violence, child management and parenting, at the centre, by home visit or over the phone, plus groups for women and children.

services.name: PPIS Family Service Centre (West)
services.desc: PPIS centre in Bukit Batok. Free, secular casework and counselling for relationship problems, family violence, parenting and child management, with group programmes for women and children.

services.name: REACH Family Service Centre
services.desc: REACH's original FSC in Bishan, running since 1999. Provides casework, counselling and information and referral to families, with night sessions by appointment.

services.name: REACH @ Sin Ming
services.desc: REACH's second FSC touchpoint, serving Sin Ming and Thomson residents. Casework, counselling and referrals for families, run by the same team as REACH Bishan.

services.name: Sembawang Family Service Centre
services.desc: Independent FSC at Sembawang Crescent. Offers casework, group work and community programmes, with a dedicated inbox for case referrals.

services.name: Serangoon Moral Family Service Centre
services.desc: Neighbourhood FSC for Serangoon residents. Offers one-to-one casework, group programmes and community projects such as a children's tuition programme.

services.name: SINDA Family Service Centre
services.desc: FSC run by the Indian community self-help group at Beatty Road, for Indian Singapore Citizens and PRs. Social work practitioners help with financial, marital, parenting and other family or relationship challenges; meetings are by appointment.

services.name: South Central Community Family Service Centre
services.org: South Central Community Family Service Centre
services.desc: Formerly Bukit Ho Swee FSC, serving low-income families in central Singapore, especially rental communities. Combines social work with livelihood support, child learning programmes and a home-ownership pathway, using an assets-based community approach.

services.name: SCC@Hoy Fatt
services.org: South Central Community Family Service Centre
services.desc: Branch of South Central Community FSC at Hoy Fatt Road. Supports low-income and rental-flat families with social work, livelihood support, children's learning and help towards home ownership.

services.name: The SBL Vision Family Service Centre
services.desc: Tampines FSC open to all, offering secular counselling and casework, groups and outreach. Also runs practical help such as milk and diaper, furniture and back-to-school assistance, money management workshops and family violence prevention talks.

services.name: THK Family Service Centre @ Bedok North
services.desc: THK centre serving Bedok North. Casework and counselling on family dynamics and emotional or behavioural concerns, including families affected by violence, abuse or neglect, plus groups such as programmes for men dealing with violence.

services.name: THK Family Service Centre @ Bukit Panjang
services.desc: THK centre at Petir Road for Bukit Panjang residents. Offers casework, counselling and referrals, including work with families affected by violence, abuse or neglect, alongside parenting and support groups.

services.name: THK Family Service Centre @ Jurong
services.desc: THK centre at Boon Lay Avenue serving Jurong and Boon Lay. Casework and counselling for family, emotional and behavioural issues, including violence, abuse and neglect, with group programmes and community partnerships.

services.name: THK Family Service Centre @ MacPherson
services.desc: THK centre on Paya Lebar Way serving MacPherson. Provides casework, counselling, information and referral, including support for families dealing with violence, abuse or neglect.

services.name: THK Family Service Centre @ Tanjong Pagar
services.desc: THK centre at Jalan Membina serving the Tanjong Pagar and Tiong Bahru area. Casework and counselling on family, emotional and behavioural concerns, including violence, abuse and neglect, plus parenting and support groups.

services.name: TRANS Family Service Centre (Bedok Reservoir)
services.desc: TRANS centre near Kaki Bukit with multilingual social workers and counsellors. Helps with money difficulties, mental health, employment, marital problems, child management and relationships through casework, groups and outreach.

services.name: TRANS Family Service Centre (Bedok)
services.desc: TRANS centre at Bedok North Avenue 2, near Bedok MRT, with multilingual social workers and counsellors. Helps with money difficulties, mental health, employment, marital problems, child management and relationships.

services.name: TRANS Family Service Centre (Bukit Timah)
services.desc: TRANS centre at Toh Yi Drive near Beauty World. Multilingual team offering intake, casework, counselling, groups and outreach for financial, mental health, employment, marital and parenting concerns.

services.name: Viriya Family Service Centre
services.desc: Serves Potong Pasir, Joo Seng and Bidadari. Casework and counselling for family, health, marital and money struggles, with active ageing, caregiver and grief support groups, and evening hours on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

services.name: Whampoa Family Service Centre
services.desc: Kampong Kapor Community Services' second FSC, serving Whampoa, Balestier and Novena. Casework and counselling for financial, marital, parenting and personal concerns, plus group and community work.

services.name: Whispering Hearts Family Service Centre
services.desc: Viriya's Jurong West centre for Boon Lay, Nanyang and Pioneer residents. Casework and counselling for parenting, marital, health, money and job challenges, with mental wellness and grief groups, a youth support group and children's mentoring.

services.name: Yishun Family Service @ Children's Society
services.desc: FSC run by Singapore Children's Society at Yishun Ring Road. Its casework commonly focuses on keeping family members safe, financial stability, mental health and strengthening how families function.
